reference_text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.

review_directions.mara-v1: Practical warmth. Test a smile, a fair price, and a calm command.
review_directions.jory-v1: Rough but thoughtful. Keep the softer moments clear.
review_directions.tomas-v1: Light, quick, dry wit. Let a serious promise carry weight.
review_directions.ilyra-v1: Measured authority with a worn edge. Give her room for delight.
review_directions.bren-v1: Intimate tenor with hesitant starts. Test a confident warning too.
review_directions.hearth-v1: Rounded, welcoming middle voice. Casting target: mature adult with an easy laugh.
review_directions.reed-v1: Bright, precise tenor. Casting target: young adult with quick changes of pace.
review_directions.flint-v1: Dry, low voice. Casting target: older adult with a sharp sense of humour.
review_directions.oak-v1: Deep, patient bass. Casting target: older adult who can sound playful.
review_directions.lark-v1: Bright, light voice. Casting target: young adult with clear resolve under pressure.
review_directions.ash-v1: Grainy, unhurried baritone. Casting target: mature adult with lively storytelling rhythm.
review_directions.brook-v1: Soft, direct middle voice. Casting target: mature adult with a firm, ringing warning.
review_directions.stone-v1: Dry, clipped middle voice. Casting target: mature adult with precise comic timing.

proposed.name: Cedar
proposed.description: An older adult woman with a resonant low alto, a light Ghanaian English accent, unhurried musical phrasing, and warm, clear consonants. She sounds amused, capable, and attentive. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
proposed.purpose: An elder with warmth and musical rhythm. Try her as a healer, a stern creditor, and a travelling storyteller.

proposed.name: Wren
proposed.description: A young adult with an androgynous light middle voice, a light Indian English accent, nimble precise consonants, and a thoughtful rhythm with small pauses. Warm, curious, and quietly confident. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
proposed.purpose: A youthful voice with a distinct rhythm and gender presentation. Try a courier, a careful scholar, and a company leader.

proposed.name: Copper
proposed.description: A middle-aged man with a clear high baritone, a light Turkish accent in fluent English, forward resonance, rounded vowels, and brisk conversational pacing. Expressive, sociable, and capable of gentle seriousness. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
proposed.purpose: A clear, animated baritone to contrast with the grainy and quiet men. Try a host, a farmer, and a worried parent.
